structure.unit: Civilian Protection in Cases of Police Misconduct

law.catch_line: Civilian protection in cases of police misconduct; minimum standards

text.section: State, local, and other public law-enforcement agencies, which have ten or more law-enforcement officers, shall have procedures as established in subsection B, allowing citizen submission of complaints regarding the conduct of the law-enforcement agency, law-enforcement officers in the agency, or employees of the agency.

Law-enforcement agencies shall ensure, at a minimum, that in the case of all written complaints:
The general public has access to the required forms and information concerning the submission of complaints;
The law-enforcement agency assists individuals in filing complaints; and
Adequate records are maintained of the nature and disposition of such cases.
